refusal.PERSON_NOT_ACTIVE: This person is no longer active in the company.
refusal.PERSON_OTHER_COMPANY: This person belongs to another company.
refusal.RLS_IS_EMPLOYEE: An RLS is a person of the company, elected or designated among the workers; a territorial RLS is an RLST.
refusal.RLST_IS_OUTSIDE: A territorial RLS (RLST) is an outside contact, not a person of the company.
refusal.SHIFT_ONLY_TEAMS: Only a first-aid or a fire and emergency team is appointed per shift.
refusal.SHIFT_OTHER_COMPANY: This shift belongs to another company.
refusal.SITE_OTHER_COMPANY: This site belongs to another company.
refusal.CONTACT_OTHER_PARTY: This contact belongs to another organisation.
refusal.ENDS_BEFORE_START: A term ends on or after its first day.
refusal.ALREADY_APPOINTED: This person already holds this role here.
refusal.ENDED: This term has ended: a new term is a new appointment.
refusal.SIGNED_ALREADY: The appointee's signature is recorded already; it is written once.
refusal.NAME_MISMATCH: The name typed is not the appointee's.
refusal.LETTER_MISSING: Upload the signed letter first: a paper signature is recorded with its scan.
refusal.NOTICE_NOT_PENDING: This notice is filed or cancelled already.
refusal.FILED_IN_FUTURE: The day it was filed is today or before.
refusal.FILED_BEFORE_APPOINTMENT: A notice is filed on or after the day the RLS was elected or designated.
refusal.NOT_OPEN: This deadline is done or cancelled: only its note changes.
refusal.EVIDENCE_MISSING: This deadline asks for evidence: upload it first, then mark it done.
refusal.OWNER_NOT_ALLOWED: This person may not own a deadline of this company.
refusal.DUE_TOO_FAR: That day is too far ahead (at most ten years).

problem.read: It could not be read just now.
problem.unavailable: The server did not answer. Try again in a moment.
problem.noAnswer: No answer came back: it may or may not have been saved. Read again before trying once more.
problem.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again.
problem.forbidden: You may not do this here.
problem.stepUp: This needs a fresh authenticator code.
problem.conflict: Someone else changed it meanwhile. Read again, then try once more.
problem.invalid: It was refused as it is. Check the fields.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a moment.
problem.contract: This page and the server do not agree. Reload the page.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on the server.
problem.file: The file could not be opened.

roleLaw.EMPLOYER: Who holds the responsibility for the organisation and its workers.
roleLaw.RSPP: Head of the prevention and protection service, appointed by the employer.
roleLaw.ASPP: Member of the prevention and protection service.
roleLaw.DOCTOR: The occupational doctor runs the health surveillance.
roleLaw.RLS: Workers' safety representative, elected or designated among the workers.
roleLaw.RLST: Territorial workers' representative, where the company has no RLS of its own.
roleLaw.SUPERVISOR: Oversees that work is done safely and stops it when it is not.
roleLaw.MANAGER: Carries out the employer's directions on safety.
roleLaw.FIRST_AID: Workers trained and appointed for first aid.
roleLaw.FIRE_EMERGENCY: Workers trained and appointed for fire fighting and emergencies.

roleHint.RSPP: A person of the company or an outside consultant.
roleHint.ASPP: Named when the company has one.
roleHint.DOCTOR: Usually an outside doctor: an outside contact.
roleHint.RLS: A person of the company; the notice to INAIL follows.
roleHint.RLST: An outside contact; the notice to INAIL follows.
roleHint.SUPERVISOR: Named per site when the company has them.
roleHint.MANAGER: Named when the company has them.
roleHint.FIRST_AID: A team per site, per shift if you work in shifts.
roleHint.FIRE_EMERGENCY: A team per site, per shift if you work in shifts.

law.organisation: The employer names who holds each safety role and keeps the chart in the risk assessment.
